ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino acid deamination by Penicillium and surface flora during 2-mo ripening.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole from raw Montbeliarde milk pasture plus natural rind Brevibacterium.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and Penicillium glaucum/roqueforti proteases.

blue_moldy.reason: Methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from fatty acid beta-oxidation by Penicillium.

browning.reason: Maillard between free amino acids from proteolysis and residual galactose on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic acids from Penicillium lipase lipolysis of milk triglycerides.

creaminess.reason: 30% fat plus Penicillium proteolysis softening pressed paste to creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed uncooked curd with blue fissures gives some fracture but not dry-grana crumble.

firmness.reason: Pressed uncooked texture at ~43% moisture and 2-mo age gives sliceable semi-firm body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism, low in mild cow blue.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids by Penicillium esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic/capric acids, no goat-milk branched-chain acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism plus Strecker aldehydes on aging.

melt.reason: Rennet gel pH ~6.1 with solubilized colloidal calcium allows good flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation by Penicillium lipoxygenase.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from lipolyzed fat globules and coalesced fat on melting.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic starter plus low acetic acid from heterofermentation.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching, proteolyzed rennet network does not form aligned fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal H2S/methional from methionine, uncooked curd and mild Penicillium sulfur metabolism.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and sweet amino acids proline/alanine, mostly fermented.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from rennet and Penicillium proteolysis of casein.
